352401.title: No broken diamond in hexagon conjecture for modified crystal operator paths
352401.review_depth: arXiv:2110.15394 v1/v2; v2 read in full (an extended abstract). Independent implementation of Defs 3.1/3.2/4.1/4.3/5.1, validated against the paper's Corollary 6.8 in 6048+264 A_3 cases and cross-checked with the inherited implementation (32032 agreements in A_4).
352401.result: Literal violation of Conjecture 5.5 in A_3 at |alpha| = 5: alpha = (1,3)+(1,4)+2(2,4)+(3,4), k_1 = 1, k_2 = 3 (lambda = (7,7,5,0), mu = (5,5,5,4)). E_2 traverses a broken-diamond edge inside e_2^{k_2}(alpha). All violations found (A_3 |alpha|<=9, A_4 |alpha|<=7) lie on paths that later die. No completed hexagon meets a BD edge, and in A_3 the paper's Theorem 5.3 and Corollary 6.8 still hold, so this may be judged a formulation defect. Separately, the paper's main formula (Theorem 6.6 / Corollary 6.8, conditional on Conjectures 5.5 and 6.4) FAILS in A_4 for lambda = (5,4,4,4,0), mu = (4,4,3,3,3): K = t^4+t^5+t^6+t^7 (Kostka number 4 by SSYT count), but the fixed points give t^4+2t^5+t^6+t^7. The cause is a hexagon broken on both sides (no BD edge involved).
352401.novelty_status: No full version found. Schultze's PhD thesis (Albany 2021) PDF returned 403 (not retried): material source gap.
352401.remaining: Read the thesis's version of the definitions and conjecture. Root judgement on literal versus intended scope. See outputs/352401-crystal-note.md.

346745.title: Parity congruences for hard-hexagon partition functions
346745.review_depth: Source arXiv:2006.01691v1 (only version) Sections 2 and 4 read. Inherited proof (outputs/hexagon-proof.md) re-derived and checked line by line in this lane.
346745.result: Merca's Conjecture 1 holds for all k >= 1 and s. By source eq. (2)/(4) plus Gauss's identity, the bilateral series equals Theta*F_s. Then (-1)^k(Theta_k F_s - H_s) = 2 sum_{h>=0} q^{2a^2}(1-q^{4a+2})F_s with a = k+1+2h, and (1-q^2)F_s >= 0 termwise (the n=0,1 terms combined for s=1). Identity checked to q^4096 (logs/hexagon-4096.log, inherited).

346745.remaining: None mathematical. Root decides on routine exclusion.

342364.title: The 2-adic valuation conjecture for even-colored 2-ary partition functions
342364.review_depth: Full source read (arXiv:1904.03398v1, the only version; published Ramanujan J. 55 (2021) 623-660 with the same Conjecture 6.1 text). Complete ordinary proof written (outputs/342364-proof.md). Exact certificates and cross-checks run. Literature: OpenAlex citing works (2), web searches, and Omega/OpenAI registry trees.
342364.result: The even-case equality nu2(c_{2k}(4n)-c_{2k}(n)) = nu2(n)+2nu2(k)+3 is PROVED for all k,n. Both odd inequalities (>= nu2(n)+3 for m=4k+1; >= nu2(n)+6 for m=4k+3) are PROVED for all k. The final clause 'in each case the equality holds for infinitely many n' is FALSE for every k ≡ 3 (mod 4): for m = 4k+3 ≡ 15 (mod 16), nu2(c_m(4n)-c_m(n)) >= nu2(n)+7 for all n. It is true in all other cases: equality at every odd n (m ≡ 1 mod 4; m ≡ 3, 7 mod 16), at every n ≡ 2 mod 4 (m ≡ 11 mod 16), and at every n for even m. The first failure is m=15 (k=3), just beyond the source's numerical range m <= 10. Example: c_15(4)-c_15(1) = 48000 = 2^7*375.
342364.mechanism: Generating-function operator: sum c_m(2^j n)x^n = C^m A_j(y), y=x/(1-x), w=1+2y; U_2 acts via Chebyshev polynomials. Factor d_j = A_{j+2}-A_j = y(1+y) r_j with r_{j+1} = Ttilde(r_j), where Ttilde(y^{2e}) = 2y^e U_{m+e}(1+2y) and Ttilde(y^{2e+1}) = y^e (U_{m+e+1}-U_{m+e})(1+2y). A bit-length weight increases by >= 1 per step (Lemma W). Even m: r_0 = rho + Ttilde(rho) with rho = 8U_{k-1}(1+2y)^2 (Pell identity), plus a leading-term invariant. Odd m: half-angle operator T', a crude bound nu2(r_{0,F}) >= 2F+3, and three low-coefficient facts proved by exact binomial-basis interpolation with a proved degree bound.
checks: logs/valscan-N2048-m65-128.log brute force m=65..128, n<=2048 (consistent; sharp constant nu2(m+1)+3 observed for m=79,95,111,127)
logs/lemmaW-test.log randomised + exhaustive-monomial stress test of Lemma W (6249 cases, 0 failures)
342364.novelty_status: No resolution found (OpenAlex citations: Sobolewski 2023 and Żmija 2023 read at abstract level, both unrelated; Semantic Scholar 429, not retried; web searches standard and extended). Omega d5f7c3fd and OpenAI 4eaee875 trees have no matching entry. No prior campaign coverage.

342364.remaining: Independent review of Sections 3-5 of the proof. Formal Lean endpoint (step 3 of PLAN.md is the main cost). Root decision on significance, given that the falsity is in the sharpness clause while the inequalities are proved.
